packageRules.description: Coupled vitest group: the pinned vitest version moves together with the fixed runner identity (DEV_VALIDATION_VITEST_VERSION, picture-perfect runtime_id). Never bundled with unrelated updates.

Coupled mcp group: the nested mcp declaration moves in one isolated PR so it stays reviewable against the Dependabot-owned root requirements-dev.txt (mcp runtime/dependency parity). Never bundled with unrelated updates.
Node engine updates keep their own PR scope, separate from dependency updates, preserving the fixed Node runtime identity (host runner pins Node 22).
Remaining nested-only minor/patch surfaces, excluding the coupled groups above. Root pip (requirements-dev.txt) and GitHub Actions stay with Dependabot — this config never touches them.
Major version upgrades stay separate for manual review
